description: This file contains test cases for the VoiceWakeHelpers module, including functions like sanitizing voice trigger phrases, normalizing locale identifiers, and ensuring proper limits and fallbacks are applied.

classes.name: VoiceWakeHelpersTests
classes.description: A test suite for VoiceWakeHelpers functions, validating trimming, defaults fallback, length and count limits, and locale normalization.

methods.name: `sanitize triggers trims and drops empty`
methods.description: Tests that empty or whitespace-only strings are trimmed or dropped from voice wake trigger lists.

methods.name: `sanitize triggers falls back to defaults`
methods.description: Checks that when all triggers are empty or whitespace, the default triggers are used.

methods.name: `sanitize triggers limits word length`
methods.description: Ensures that trigger words exceeding maximum length are truncated to the maximum allowed length.

methods.name: `sanitize triggers limits word count`
methods.description: Verifies that the number of trigger words does not exceed the maximum allowed count.

methods.name: `normalize locale strips collation`
methods.description: Checks that locale identifiers with collation variants are normalized by removing the collation part.

methods.name: `normalize locale strips unicode extensions`
methods.description: Verifies that Unicode extension segments are stripped from locale identifiers during normalization.
